newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks nudge higher in quiet London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks nudge higher in quiet London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were marked gently higher in London trading as firmness among British financial firms fed through and the Dow gave prices a further nudge late on, dealers said.
"Hong Kong banks have been helped a bit by firmer UK banks. But it's been pretty quiet overall," a trader at a European bank said.
At 1450 GMT, HSBC was up 23 pence, or 1.48 percent, at 1579p.
The Hang Seng London reference index was up 34.25 points, or 0.27 percent, to 12,761.08. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index added 19.79 points, or 0.16 percent, to close at 12,726.83.
